rules.text: The actor for REQUEST-01 must limit the operation to the assigned approver; it must also exclude unassigned participants.
The allowed current states for REQUEST-01 must allow the operation only from PENDING; it must also exclude every other state.
The authentication for REQUEST-01 must require an authenticated session; it must also reject an expired session.

The business side effects for REQUEST-01 must create one non-authoritative business record for the committed decision; it must also execute that business effect only after the authoritative decision commit.
The command for REQUEST-01 must bind the command to the request identifier; it must also carry the expected request version.
The concurrency for REQUEST-01 must require the expected request version; it must also reject a stale version without mutation.
The default result for REQUEST-01 must select COMMITTED as the default result class after all owned guards pass; it must also bind the default result class to the successful decision outcome.
The delivery effects for REQUEST-01 must queue one notice per intended recipient; it must also keep delivery failure separate from decision commit.

The expected domain mutation for REQUEST-01 must apply one authoritative decision state change to the bound request on successful commit; it must also set the request decision to the submitted approval outcome.
The forbidden mutations for REQUEST-01 must preserve the request author; it must also preserve the uploaded document bytes.
The forbidden states for REQUEST-01 must forbid the operation from ARCHIVED; it must also forbid the operation from FINAL.
The history result for REQUEST-01 must append one immutable decision event; it must also preserve every earlier event.
The idempotency for REQUEST-01 must reuse the prior result for the same attempt key; it must also prevent a duplicate mutation.
The input invariants for REQUEST-01 must require a non-empty reason when declining; it must also reject a whitespace-only reason.
The object binding for REQUEST-01 must target one stated request and its document; it must also reject a target outside that binding.
The preconditions for REQUEST-01 must require the request to be ready for a decision; it must also reject a request with unresolved validation blocks.
The recovery for REQUEST-01 must permit retry after a correctable failure; it must also retain the submitted input.
The rejection for REQUEST-01 must report the failing rule; it must also leave the request and document unchanged.
The relationship predicate for REQUEST-01 must require the actor assignment to the request; it must also reject an unrelated actor.
The result expectations for REQUEST-01 must state the committed and guarded no-op result classes; it must reference action:ACT-CAL-REQUEST-01:forbidden_mutations.
The superseded rules for REQUEST-01 must contain the stable reference SUPERSESSION-CAL-REQUEST-01.
The test obligations for REQUEST-01 must contain the stable reference TEST-CAL-REQUEST-01.
The trace for REQUEST-01 must contain the stable reference TRACE-CAL-REQUEST-01.
The version result for REQUEST-01 must increment the request version once on commit; it must also avoid incrementing it on rejection.
The visible error for REQUEST-01 must show the failure category and retained input; it must reference action:ACT-CAL-REQUEST-01:input_invariants.
The visible success for REQUEST-01 must show the decision and resulting request version; it must reference action:ACT-CAL-REQUEST-01:expected_domain_mutation.

The allowed transitions for DOCUMENT-01 must allow DRAFT to PENDING; it must also allow PENDING to FINAL.
The authority for DOCUMENT-01 must limit transitions to the assigned approver; it must also reject transition attempts by other actors.
The boundary conditions for DOCUMENT-01 must require validation before entering PENDING; it must also require a decision before entering FINAL.
The current states for DOCUMENT-01 must define DRAFT, PENDING, FINAL, and ARCHIVED; it must also exclude undeclared states.
The forbidden transitions for DOCUMENT-01 must forbid FINAL to DRAFT; it must also forbid ARCHIVED to PENDING.
The history preservation for DOCUMENT-01 must preserve the transition and reversal history; it must reference lifecycle:LC-CAL-DOCUMENT-01:required_evidence.
The object outcome for DOCUMENT-01 must retain the document when the request is finalized; it must also bind the final decision to that document.
The required confirmation for DOCUMENT-01 must require explicit confirmation before finalization; it must also reject an absent confirmation.
The required evidence for DOCUMENT-01 must require the current document as decision evidence; it must also reject evidence bound to another request.
The required reason for DOCUMENT-01 must require a non-empty reason when declining a transition; it must also require a non-empty reason when requesting a reversal.
The reversal window for DOCUMENT-01 must permit reversal only before archival; it must also close reversal after the stated deadline.
The reversibility for DOCUMENT-01 must state the reversible interval and the irreversible boundary; it must reference lifecycle:LC-CAL-DOCUMENT-01:boundary_conditions.
